## Choose the expansion (1) {#check-one}

Expand $(3x-4)^2$. Identify the pattern on paper, then choose the matching expansion.

<div class="index-check" role="group" aria-label="Choose the expanded expression">

<button type="button" data-choice="a" aria-pressed="false">A. $9x^2+16$</button>
<button type="button" data-choice="b" aria-pressed="false">B. $9x^2-12x+16$</button>
<button type="button" data-choice="c" aria-pressed="false">C. $9x^2-24x-16$</button>
<button type="button" data-choice="d" aria-pressed="false">D. $9x^2-24x+16$</button>

</div>

<div class="check-feedback" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">
<div data-result="a" hidden>

You squared the two terms. Write $(3x-4)(3x-4)$ and include both cross products. Try again.

</div>
<div data-result="b" hidden>

You counted one cross product, $(3x)(-4)$. What does the other cross product add? Try again.

</div>
<div data-result="c" hidden>

Your middle term is correct. The constant comes from $(-4)(-4)$. Check its sign and try again.

</div>
<div data-result="d" hidden>

**Correct.** Both brackets are identical. Use $(a+b)^2=a^2+2ab+b^2$ with $b=-4$.

$(3x-4)^2=(3x)^2+2(3x)(-4)+(-4)^2=9x^2-24x+16$.

</div>
</div>

<button class="reset-check" type="button" hidden>Try again from the start</button>
